Changelog

We continuously update our data, tools, and guides to ensure you have the most accurate commercial energy intelligence.

November 2026

Initial Public Launch

Launched the core Bill Decoder tool, 28 foundational glossary pages, and the Commercial Rate Patterns library. All data sourced from public EIA and OpenEI records.

Upcoming: Q1 2027

URDB Data Expansion

We will be ingesting the full OpenEI Utility Rate Database to expand our tariff library from 28 to over 1,400 specific rate schedules, complete with state-by-state demand charge indexing.
